_doc: Large batch L04 (Sonnet generic pass): family corrections only; colour/lift/snd left to builder defaults.

cliff-ram/f:b1.note: gore = horn point, keeps slash for the hoof scrape only

cliff-ram/f:u2.note: head lowered, horns pointing at the foe; ram keeps bash for Butt, Horn-Down Ram and Shove

wild-boar/f:b0.note: a tusk gore is an upward rip, not jaws (tusk keyword misfires); thrust stays with Tusk Gore

wild-boar/f:u1.note: a wallow is a mud pool: ripples instead of a plain shield

wild-boar/f:u3.note: rooting up turf and roots: leaf is the nearest picture

prairie-bison/f:b1.note: horn toss = horn point lifting, slash kept for hoof scrape and Stampede

desert-camel/f:u0.note: spit = drops flung out (trip tag is the mechanic)

desert-camel/f:u1.note: a long straight leg kick, not a slash

caribou-bull/f:b1.note: antler clash = thump of two heads

caribou-bull/f:x0.note: antler toss lifts on the tines

caribou-bull/f:u1.note: antler tines hook: web is wrong for antlers

caribou-bull/f:u3.note: head shake flicks the antlers; shock (electric) does not fit

musk-ox/f:x0.note: horns pressed in a ring point inward

musk-ox/f:u3.note: wool snag = wool tangled on the foe (trip)

ibex-patriarch/f:b1.note: horn sweep with huge curved horns reads as points; Horn Sweep unique keeps bash

ibex-patriarch/f:u3.note: a stare, not a web: glint of the eyes

wood-bison/f:b1.note: plough = snow thrown up, greyer puffs

wild-bactrian/f:u2.note: dust mantle = a cloak of dust, art beats thorns tag
